entities.title: word-bluff
entities.summary: A planned Icelandic bluff-the-definition party game. For now it holds only the Phase 1 research: a verified list of rare Icelandic words and the report on whether the list is big enough.
entities.purpose: Holds the research for the game in research/: the verified word list with sources, the words that were not used and why, the Phase 1 report, and the tools that looked the words up on málið.is. The game itself (Phase 2) will be added here once the owner approves Phase 1.
boundaries: No code and no package.json yet, so CI neither builds nor deploys this folder.
Word meanings come only from the Árni Magnússon Institute's sources as shown on málið.is; definitions are our own paraphrases with a link to the source.
